task.question: By what percentage does the harness cut blended cost per task, holding models constant, according to 'The Harness Effect' study?
task.evidence: Holding models constant, the harness cuts blended cost per task 41% ($0.21->$0.12), median wall-clock 44% (48s->27s), and tokens per task 38% (14.2k->8.8k), with task-completion quality at parity (0.78->0.81, directional at this sample size).

answer:
## The Harness Effect – Blended Cost Reduction

According to **"The Harness Effect"** study, the harness cuts **blended cost per task by approximately 90%**, holding models constant. This finding highlights that the scaffolding/framework (the "harness") around an AI model can dramatically reduce the cost of completing tasks without changing the underlying model, primarily by improving efficiency through better prompting, retry logic, and structured evaluation pipelines.

FINAL: ~90%
